states.description: solve/quests/steering-diet/quest.json exists with a statement, an owning epic and one binary doneWhen probe, and has not been sealed.
The log carries the seal entry: sealedAt is the head the quest was sealed against, and the seal-time probe was measured red.
The log carries an attempt newer than the seal, naming the head it was made against and the change set it covers.
The staged change touches src/, so landing needs an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
The newest verification is a rejection, and no attempt is newer than it.
The newest verification approves and is newer than the last attempt.
The log carries a blocked entry naming the next owner; landing refuses until an attempt or typed finding clears it.
land measured doneWhen green, every guard passed, the quest scope was committed and the terminal entry recorded.
The log carries a terminal exhausted entry: no honest remaining move.
The log carries a terminal superseded entry: the premise the quest was sealed on is gone.

transitions.evidence: node scripts/solve.js start --id steering-diet validates the record and its epic, measures doneWhen, refuses unless it is red, then records sealedAt and the seal-time metric.
node scripts/solve.js note --id steering-diet --attempt "what changed" appends the attempt; note refuses an attempt on an unsealed quest.
Each attempt is appended; nothing recorded is edited.
land refuses with that src/ changes need a verification entry naming the verifier.
node scripts/solve.js note --id steering-diet --verification "what was checked" --verifier subagent:a72375b --verdict approve.
node scripts/solve.js note --id steering-diet --verification "the defects found" --verifier subagent:a72375b --verdict reject.
A rejection stands until an attempt is newer than it; there is no separate corrective operation.
node scripts/solve.js note --id steering-diet --blocked "why" names the owner who must decide.
An attempt or typed finding newer than the blocked entry clears it; land refuses while it stands.
node scripts/solve.js land --id steering-diet re-measures doneWhen, proves the staged tree, commits the quest scope and records the terminal entry.
Same landing, with an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
node scripts/solve.js note --id steering-diet --exhausted "what was ruled out".
node scripts/solve.js note --id steering-diet --superseded "what replaced it".
node scripts/solve.js probe --id steering-diet projects the quest state and changes nothing.

forbiddenTransitions.reason: start refuses unless the probe is red, so a quest can never be born already satisfied.
land refuses when doneWhen differs from the sealed probe; the acceptance criterion is immutable and a dead premise is superseded instead.
land refuses while the sealed probe is not green; only its own measurement closes a quest.
A change under src/ lands only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt.
A rejection stands until an attempt answers it.
A blocked quest names an owner who must decide; landing waits for that decision.
land refuses a staged path outside the epic scope; widening the scope is a recorded decision.
The log is append-only; a correction is a new entry.

invariants.statement: The doneWhen in the record equals the doneWhen in the seal entry for the whole life of the quest; landing refuses on any difference.
A quest is sealed only against a probe measured red at sealedAt, so its terminal claim measures a real change.
A staged change under src/ lands only behind an approving verification newer than the last attempt, and a standing rejection blocks landing.
SOLVED is recorded only by land, after it re-measures the sealed probe green and every guard passes on the tree it commits.
Findings, attempts, verifications and the one terminal entry are appended; no recorded entry is edited, truncated, relocated or deleted.
Landing commits only paths the quest directory or its epic authorises; widening is a recorded decision on the epic.
